svg.title: Level 3: one replayer tick
svg.text: One run of the replayer Lambda (ADR-0003, ADR-0004). Every step is deterministic, so a retried or overlapping run changes nothing.
read slices for (W, W + speed min]
due lifecycle events, targets, heat map
dispatch, guarded transitions, outbox insert + delete
A failure before COMMIT leaves W unchanged,
so the retry recomputes the same tick.
